description: Gender hint classification thresholds - adjust these to fine-tune gender classification behavior

explanation.maleRatio: If female usage <= 30% (i.e., male >= 70%), classify as 'male'
explanation.minUsageCount: Minimum number of times a hanja must appear in names to be classified

history.changes: Initial thresholds based on 2024 name statistics

stricter.note: Use for higher precision, lower coverage

broader.note: Use for higher coverage, may include more ambiguous cases
